column3: “Not I will repeat again to pass by it” is rendered “I will spare them no longer”; the Hebrew wordplay between “summer fruit” and “end” is not reproduced.
“They will wail songs of the temple” is rendered “The songs of the palace will turn to wailing”; NASB supplies “them” and renders “hush!” as “in silence.”
“Put an end to” is rendered “do away with,” and “afflicted” “humble.”
NASB renders “open grain” as “open the wheat market,” “ephah” as “bushel,” and “falsify balances of deceit” as “cheat with dishonest scales.”
“If I will forget to perpetuity” is rendered “Indeed, I will never forget.”
“Like the light” is rendered “like the Nile,” following a different reading; “River of Egypt” is rendered “Nile of Egypt,” and “sink” “subside.”
“Cause the sun to go” is rendered “make the sun go down,” and “in a day of light” “in broad daylight.”
“Feasts” is rendered “festivals,” and “all loins” “everyone’s loins”; NASB supplies “a time of” and “son.”
“Rove about” is rendered “go to and fro.”
“Your gods” is rendered “your god”; NASB renders the oath forms as “As your god lives” and “As the way of Beersheba lives.”
